items.why: Already present: 'Barć' (hollow-log tree hive of Poland) is an archetype under Log hive in rebuild/out/B10.json; at most add 'tree hive · bee tree' as aliases of Barć. Tree beekeeping itself is a use tradition that stays here.

Already present: the Vaquero article (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vaquero, fetched) names the Wade saddle as the saddle of the working-ranch buckaroo tradition, and 'Wade saddle' is an archetype under Western saddle; 'buckaroo saddle' can be added as its alias.

record.d: Light Hawaiian cowboy saddle on a hand-hewn neneleau-wood tree with a concave seat and heavy rawhide rigging, its prototype dating from the early 1900s.

v.n: Big Island saddle with aweawe rigging
v.d: rawhide 'tentacle' rigging unique to Hawai‘i Island

items.why: A distinct saddle type (also held by the Smithsonian, si.edu nmah_1425863) derived from vaquero saddles; origin version of Western saddle.
Ambiguous resolved: Sheridan style is a floral leather-carving pattern applied to saddles, belts and other goods; it names a way of decorating, not a ware.
